_comment: Starting lineup of each era, used only to lay out the Drafts view. 'from' is the first season it applies; a season uses the latest entry whose 'from' is not after it. Everyone not in a starting slot goes to the bench (BE). Add a new entry when the league changes its lineup. Slot names: QB RB WR TE K D/ST plus FLEX (RB/WR/TE), W/T (WR/TE) and SFLEX (QB/RB/WR/TE).
